title: UK UFO sightings MAPPED as Pentagon releases files - check your postcode
excerpt: One UK city has emerged as a UFO hotspot. Check out out interactive map to see what UFO's have been spotted in your local area.
content:
Lauran O'Toole, Richard Ault

Updated Fri, October 30, 2026 at 2:11 PM UTC

A bombshell new map has revealed 164 UFO sightings across the UK, with mysterious black triangles spotted across the nation's skies. But have many close encounters taken place near where you live? You can use our interactive map to enter your postcode and explore every unexplained encounter between 2021 and 2026. Manchester has emerged as a UFO hotspot with 245 UFO sightings documented in the city and its surrounding area.

London follows closely behind with 197 sightings over the past five years. The UK has been hit with almost 2,000 UFO sightings in just the last five years, according to research group UFO Identified.

While orbs, spheres and "star-like" sightings make up the bulk of British sightings, researchers have logged 164 reports of similar wedge-shaped objects - meaning roughly one in every 12 sightings involves a distinctive triangle.

Witnesses across the country have reported seeing dark, matte triangles gliding soundlessly at low altitude over housing estates, farmland, and coastal areas before quickly darting away. The most recent UFO sighting of this kind came on July 22, when a large black triangle with a red light on each of its points was witnessed hovering over Stretford in Greater Manchester for around half an hour.

Meanwhile, a triangle described as being perfect was spotted speeding across the sky above Chesterfield, while a 'black V-shaped boomerang' was recorded over the Fylde coast in Lancashire, and a soundless black wedge above Exmouth in Devon. This comes as the Pentagon has been releasing batches of classified documents related to UFO sightings, including never-before-seen footage.

The US defence department uploaded the first tranche of 161 files to their website on May 8 and have released more since. One of the explosive files includes confidential testimony from a military official who claims he witnessed the infamous 1947 Roswell incident firsthand.

Meanwhile, in 1952, US Navy Chief Warrant Officer Delbert C. Newhouse, an experienced photographer, spotted a cluster of gunmetal-coloured objects flying in the clear blue sky near Tremonton, Utah.

Newhouse reported seeing 10 to 14 reflective unidentified aerial phenomena (UAP), which he described as looking like "two discs stacked on top of one another" creating a classic flying saucer shape.

He captured around 1,600 frames of the objects and submitted the footage to the US government for review. In one declassified FBI document, a former military pilot describes seeing lights in the sky in October 2023 on a flight between Boston and Dublin. He claimed that many other pilots have witnessed similar events between midnight and 3am.
